description: This file defines interfaces and data structures related to package management, including download, install, lock, and configuration functionalities within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for runtime environment, including resource limits, environment variables, and debugging options.

classes.name: IPackageDownloader
classes.description: Interface for package download management, including download, pause, resume, cancel, delete, and progress reporting.

classes.name: IPackageInstaller
classes.description: Interface for package installation management, including install, uninstall, list, configure, and retrieve package state.

classes.name: IPackageHandler
classes.description: Interface for managing package locks, unlocking, and retrieving lock information.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Initiates a package download with specified URL and options.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses an ongoing download by download ID.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused download by download ID.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download by download ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a file specified by file locator.

methods.name: Progress
methods.description: Reports download progress for a given download ID.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and used space details.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets rate limit for a download.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs a package with specified ID, version, metadata, and file locator.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package by package ID.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Configures a package with specified ID and version.

methods.name: PackageState
methods.description: Retrieves the installation state of a package.

methods.name: GetConfigForPackage
methods.description: Retrieves configuration metadata for a package given its file locator.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package with specified ID, version, and reason.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a package by package ID and version.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Retrieves lock information for a package.
